tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, chart panels, table rows on hover.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: code blocks, table headers, sidebars.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: chart gridlines, dividers, table borders, input borders. Never for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the main chart line. 13:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, axis labels, source lines. 4.5:1+ on surface-0/100/200 in both themes.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The answer: the one highlighted series, the latest data point, the mark's tail. Graphics and 24px+ text only (3.8:1 on paper). Use once per view.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Signal-coloured text at body size: key figures, links. 5.2:1+ on every light surface, 6.8:1+ dark.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Highlight bands behind a figure or a chart range under discussion. Never behind small signal text.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series 1: the series the claim is about.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series 2: comparison series. Darker than chart-1 in light, lighter in dark, so they separate by lightness too.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series 3.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series 4.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Everything else / 'other' bucket; context series.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline and the thesis claim. One per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Volume grew, but most of it came from a small group of repeat users.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Headline numbers in stat tiles. Always paired with a label and a date range.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Tables, axis ticks, query snippets, account IDs.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: source lines, stat-tile labels, tags.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon/label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; gap between a figure and its label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and chart-panel padding; gap between stacked rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop; space above a finding.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Charts, tables, rules, chart panels: data surfaces stay square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and the favicon tile (12/64 of its size). Nothing rounder.
